description:
Rooney Auctioneers are delighted to present No. 16 Granville park, St. Patrick's Rd to the market. Situated in this much sought after mature residential estate this is a fine 3 bedroom end of terrace residence on a large corner site in a well established neighbourhood within close proximity to the city centre and all its amenities.
Spacious accommodation comprises of entrance hallway, living room with wet room/WC, family room, kitchen / breakfast room, upstairs 3 bedrooms and bathroom. Attic room.  Large corner garden. Exterior Insulation 
Outside the property is further complimented by fully walled front with gated parking and rear patio and a large garage to the side.
Located in a quiet cul-de-sac within walking distance to Parkway Shopping Centre, Childers Road Retail Park, schools, crèches, and sports facilities, this home is also just 2.5km from the University of Limerick, Limerick city centre, and major routes including the M7 and M20 motorways.
Viewing is highly recommended. Contact Peter Kearney.
